arguments.question: Reproduce qualitatively Figure 9 of Lv et al. (2020) by simulating L-band H- and V-polarized brightness temperature versus soil moisture and comparing the resulting chart with the source figure.

arguments.hypothesis: At fixed representative L-band conditions, both polarizations decrease in brightness temperature as soil moisture increases; V remains warmer than H.
